answer: Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 9 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, as a result paying the terrace bond on all of them and exposing each to the sparrow slash. Because the comet audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Bonded capital sits idle for 3 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
